title: Identification of multiomics and immune infiltration-associated biomarkers for early gastric cancer: a machine learning-based diagnostic model development study
summary: serum-proteomic candidates to immune infiltration and report a glmBoost+XGBoost four-protein model (mean AUC 0.792); tissue qRT-PCR/IHC and external expression cohorts provide bounded checks. The paper notes inconsistent B2M/CFL1 expression in one validation cohort, so early-detection utility remains exploratory.
